nodes.source_text: MnSA-RuO2 was successfully synthesized via a three-step procedure (details provided in the Experimental Section). ... HRTEM images show well-defined lattice fringes ... successful atomic substitution of Ru by Mn atoms.

nodes.description: Comprehensive acidic OER evaluation in 0.5 M H2SO4

results_json.source_text: The electrochemical performance of MnSA - RuO2 toward OER was evaluated using a standard three-electrode configuration in 0.5 M H2SO4... MnSA - RuO2 achieves current densities of 100, 200... at overpotentials of 278, 324... mV... MnSA - RuO2 exhibits a Cdl value of 18.5 mFcm-2... detection of 34O2... calculated 18O incorporation was only 0.24%... observed distinct bands for *OOH and *OH intermediates.

nodes.description: Baseline acidic OER evaluation in 0.5 M H2SO4
nodes.source_text: overpotential values are substantially lower than those observed for RuO2, which requires 322, 392... 661 mV to reach the same current densities... RuO2 exhibits a Cdl value of 7.7 mFcm-2... RuO2, which showed a 53.8% increase under the same conditions.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms the RuO2 phase (PDF#43-1027). A shift to higher angles in MnSA-RuO2 suggests lattice contraction due to Mn incorporation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the XRD pattern of MnSA - RuO2 displays prominent diffraction peaks ... shift to higher angles relative to those of the reference RuO2, suggesting lattice contraction upon Mn doping

nodes.characterization_summary: Shows lattice fringes of 0.255 nm and 0.317 nm corresponding to RuO2 (101) and (110) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images show well-defined lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 0.255 nm and 0.317 nm ... corresponding to the (101) and (110) planes of RuO2

nodes.characterization_summary: Identifies isolated Mn atoms as bright spots, confirming single-atom dispersion via Z-contrast and line-scan intensity profiles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: isolated bright spots (marked by blue cycles) can be captured by utilizing the Z-contrast difference ... confirming atomic-level dispersion of Mn atoms.

features: Point defects/dopants highlighted with blue circles

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn 2p peaks at 640.2 and 641.6 eV indicate Mn2+ and higher-valence Mn; Ru 3p shift indicates electronic regulation by Mn.
nodes.evidence_snippet: high-resolution XPS spectrum of Mn 2p3/2 ... primary peaks at 640.2 eV and 641.6 eV ... positive shift in the Ru 3p3/2 binding energy is observed in MnSA - RuO2

nodes.characterization_summary: MnSA-RuO2 exhibits a smaller charge transfer resistance (Rct) compared to RuO2, decreasing with increasing potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: MnSA-RuO2 displays a smaller charge transfer resistance (Rct) than undoped RuO2 (Figure S16) ... Rct of MnSA-RuO2 gradually decreases as the potential increases

nodes.characterization_summary: Used for ECSA estimation; MnSA-RuO2 shows a Cdl of 18.5 mF/cm2, significantly higher than RuO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: estimating its electrochemically active surface area (ECSA), derived from the double-layer capacitance (Cdl) ... MnSA - RuO2 exhibits a Cdl value of 18.5 mFcm-2

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ DEMS with 18O labeling confirms only 0.24% 18O incorporation, proving OER proceeds via the AEM pathway rather than LOM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: calculated 18O incorporation was only 0.24% ... confirming the predominance of the AEM pathway.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ATR-SEIRAS identifies *OOH (1186/1222 cm-1) and *OH (2945 cm-1) intermediates at potentials from 1.3 to 1.8 V.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Complementary in situ ATR-SEIRAS spectra (Figure 7i) were conducted to distinguish the oxygen-containing intermediates at different potentials from 1.3 to 1.8 V.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM reveals a uniform, large-scale nanoparticle bridging interconnections appearance.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) ... revealing a uniform, large-scale nanoparticle bridging interconnections appearance (Figure S11).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX elemental mapping and patterns demonstrate the existence and homogeneous distribution of isolated Mn atoms in the RuO2 matrix.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) elemental mapping of Mn, Ru, and O ... demonstrates the existence of isolated Mn atoms and their homogeneous distribution in MnSA-RuO2 matrix

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ATR-SEIRAS (a form of infrared spectroscopy) was used to distinguish oxygen-containing intermediates *OOH and *OH under polarization.
nodes.evidence_snippet: in situ attenuated total reflection surface-enhanced infrared absorption spectroscopy (ATR-SEIRAS) ... observed distinct bands for *OOH (1186 and 1222 cm-1) and *OH (2945 cm-1) intermediates
